info.title: ZeroDust API
info.description: Move a wallet's entire native gas balance off an EVM chain and leave exactly 0, to any address on the same chain or bridged to another chain. Sign with the wallet's key (EIP-7702) or through MetaMask Advanced Permissions (ERC-7715, signer=permission). Supported chains change: read GET /chains and GET /direct/chains. Docs: https://zerodust.xyz/docs/api

parameters.description: key (default): EIP-7702, signed with the wallet's key. permission: a MetaMask Advanced Permission (ERC-7715) redeemed by ZeroDustPermissionRouter (cross-chain through Relay and Across only)

permission.description: signer=permission only: grant a one-time native-token-allowance to the router (as delegate, redeemer and payee) and sign the intent with the router as verifyingContract

receiveToken.description: Token delivery only: estimatedReceive/minReceive are in this ERC-20 on the destination, not native gas

bridge.description: Cross-chain only: the bridge chosen for this sweep

inputAmount.description: Exact amount routed to the bridge (source wei)

expectedOutput.description: What the bridge expects to deliver (destination wei)

intent.description: Fields to include in EIP-712 signature

callData.description: Bridge calldata; keccak256(callData) == routeHash. Lets the client check the route before signing

authNonce.description: Transaction count for EIP-7702 authorization (signer=key only)

minimumBalanceWei.description: AMOUNT_TOO_LOW: the smallest balance a bridge would take (estimate)

post.summary: Create EIP-712 typed data for SweepIntent signing
post.description: Returns typed data for signing a sweep intent. Uses user's EOA as verifyingContract (EIP-7702).

contractAddress.description: Contract address for EIP-7702 delegation (the permission router for signer=permission quotes)

post.summary: Typed data for one signature over several chains (permission quotes)
post.description: Returns the EIP-712 SweepBatch for signer=permission quotes of one wallet, one per chain, in the order given. Sign it once (no chain id in the domain), then POST /sweep for each quote with the same signature and batchQuoteIds in this order.

post.summary: Submit signed authorization to execute sweep
post.description: Submit EIP-712 SweepIntent signature and EIP-7702 authorization (or, for a signer=permission quote, the MetaMask permission context). Idempotent - returns existing sweep if quoteId already submitted.

revokeAuthorization.description: Required: EIP-7702 authorization revoking the delegation (address(0), same chain, nonce + 1). Its gas is in the quoted fee; a sweep without it is refused (REVOKE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED)

permissionContext.description: signer=permission quotes only (instead of the EIP-7702 authorizations): the context MetaMask returned for the native-token-allowance granted to the router

batchQuoteIds.description: signer=permission quotes only: every quote the signature covers, in the order of POST /authorization/batch (default: this quote alone)
